newsitem.title: USA: Clinton leaves Florida hospital in wheelchair.
newsitem.headline: Clinton leaves Florida hospital in wheelchair.

text.p: President Bill Clinton left a Florida hospital in a wheelchair on Friday and was driven to a local airport for a flight to Washington, where he will have knee surgery at Bethesda Naval Hospital.

Reporters saw Clinton leave St Mary's Hospital in West Palm Beach, Florida in a wheelchair for the drive to a local airport. He was admitted to the hospital after he fell on some steps in the middle of the night at the estate of Australian golfer Greg Norman and injured his knee.
Clinton was to be flown to Andrews Airforce Base in suburban Maryland and would be taken directly to Bethesda Naval Hospital where doctors would examine him, the White House said.
Doctors described the injury as a tear in the quadriceps tendon and said that the tendon had been pulled from the bone. The surgery was to sew the tendon back to his kneecap, they said.
